description:
MMAUD
	


	
		
	
	
		A Comprehensive Multi-Modal Anti-UAV Dataset for Modern Miniature Drone Threats
	





Camera · LiDAR · mmWave radar · Audio · Leica ground truth
MMAUD brings complementary sensing modalities together for drone detection, classification, tracking and trajectory estimation. This repository provides the recordings, extracted data, calibration resources and practical guides in one public download location.
